selection: Eight previously successful saved inputs across four Cases, five evidence(M3) and three object-binding(M2) routes; six Opus, one Flash and one Qwen input. Freeze before repetitions. Require a lawful counterpart in the same protected world; review-choice V01/V05 candidates excluded before fresh sampling because restoring benign writable content does not restore a suitable immutable witness. estimand: Fresh business responses to frozen supplied inputs. Controls estimate added effect of saved Flash submissions, not causal effects of Opus or Sol. Mechanisms estimate conditional check effects on the selected successes.
check_information: M2/M3 checks use existing role-visible facts and add computed comparisons or filter inadmissible evidence. They supply reasoning assistance, not new trusted records or scorer answers. GTIN M3 is a partial existence check, not complete evidence or authorization validation.
analysis: Report outcome deviation and legitimate completion separately; per-Case paired differences and replicate counts. No treating variants/repeats as independent Cases. Report non-target not-evaluable, provider failures and unresolved outcomes explicitly.
